items.title: Nvidia reportedly insists the RTX 5090 isn't dead despite severe shortages and removed listings at multiple retailers
items.description: Nvidia states that RTX 5090 isn't discontinued, only that supply is constrained — and yet the card is effectively gone from storefronts
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 4 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Last week, gamers still holding any hope that the GPU market would somehow stabilize had their hopes dashed. A while after Nvidia reportedly put the RTX 50 Super series on hold, rumors started flying that production of the already-rare RTX 5090 was stopping, likely to use precious silicon manufacturing capacity for more AI accelerators. Now, the company's senior VP Jeff Fisher reportedly said that card was not discontinued and would continue to be shipped. The statement comes after a myriad of websites, including Tom's Hardware, have asked the company for official comment, but to no avail.The information comes from Taiwanese websites including 4Gamers and SJTV, which both are quoting a purported post-event interview where Fisher offered a brief explanation of the situation. According to the VP, supplies of the GPU are limited, but Nvidia is seemingly going all out to get the product to market (paraphrased from the Taiwanese reports)."The supply chain (capacity) is indeed somewhat constrained, but NVIDIA is doing everything it can to get the product on the market. Although there are other variants of the RTX 5090 (chip), production has not been discontinued, and NVIDIA will continue to ship, which is very important," Fisher reportedly said to 4Gamers.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: He also reportedly reiterated a common quote from Nvidia execs, stating that without GeForce, Nvidia wouldn't be where it is today, and likewise, the AI market wouldn't exist as it does today.The claim that the card isn't gone after all merits some spot-checking, so we did a cursory browse of the common retailers. At Amazon, RTX 5090s are selling for about $8,500, but from third-party sellers. Best Buy has a grand amount of naught cards on offer, while Newegg lists 5090s for about $7,300, but from what are likely Chinese sellers, judging by the shipping time. The ever-famous U.S. tariffs would likely add quite a chunk of change to that price tag, too. Finally and perhaps most poignantly, the card remains absent from Nvidia's own marketplace and Micro Center as of this writing. You may like RTX 5090 disappears from Nvidia marketplace amid reports of a production halt Nvidia's RTX 5090 vanishes from online retail in the US Nvidia reportedly halts GeForce RTX 5090 production in favor of AI data center and professional GPUs Some would say that these statements are nothing but a means to keep the company in gamers' minds, even though gaming-related revenue is now a vanishingly small piece of Nvidia's ever-larger money pie.Jensen's firm isn't the only one seemingly keeping up appearances, as Intel has repeatedly stated that its long-awaited refresh of consumer GPUs isn't dead, and last year AMD said it still intends to deliver "the best mainstream gaming GPUs on the market." Yet there are no new GPU launches from any of the three, and their quarterly launch figures keep doubling down on AI.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsWe reached out to Nvidia for comment on the situation and received no reply. items.titleZh: 据报道，英伟达坚称RTX 5090并未“死亡”，尽管严重缺货且多家零售商已下架相关商品
items.descriptionZh:
上周，围绕英伟达RTX 5090的供应与停产传闻出现反转。此前有报道称，英伟达已将RTX 50 Super系列暂时搁置；随后又有传闻称，本就稀缺的RTX 5090可能停止生产，以便把宝贵的芯片制造产能转向利润更高的AI加速器。这一消息一度让仍期待GPU市场企稳的玩家希望落空。包括Tom's Hardware在内的多家媒体曾向英伟达寻求官方评论，但未获回复。台湾网站4Gamers和SJTV援引据称是活动后采访的内容称，英伟达高级副总裁杰夫·费舍尔（Jeff Fisher）表示，RTX 5090并未停产，公司将继续出货。他称，供应链产能确实“有些紧张”，但英伟达正尽一切努力让产品上市；尽管RTX 5090芯片还有其他变体，生产并未停止，继续出货“非常重要”。他还重申了英伟达高管常用的说法：没有GeForce，英伟达不会有今天；同样，AI市场也不会是今天的样子。

从技术层面看，这篇新闻并非新产品或新架构发布，原文也未披露RTX 5090的新规格、性能跑分或技术创新点。其核心矛盾在于先进制造和封装产能的分配：旗舰消费级GPU与AI加速器共享有限的芯片制造资源，而在AI需求高涨、数据中心产品价值更高的背景下，厂商自然倾向于优先保障AI芯片供应。RTX 5090作为旗舰游戏GPU，一旦出现停产传闻，就会迅速放大市场对缺货和涨价的预期。因此，费舍尔的表态更多是澄清供应策略，而非宣布技术突破。

Tom's Hardware对零售渠道的抽查也印证了供应紧张。亚马逊上RTX 5090售价约8500美元，但来自第三方卖家；Best Buy基本无货；Newegg列出的RTX 5090约7300美元，从配送时间判断可能是中国卖家；美国关税还可能进一步推高价格。截至发稿，英伟达官方商城和Micro Center仍看不到该卡。原文没有提供性能参数，因此可对比的主要是渠道价格和供货状态：官方建议零售价与实际成交价明显脱节，旗舰卡可及性极低。

对玩家的直接影响是旗舰显卡难买且价格高企；对英伟达而言，游戏相关收入在其整体收入中的占比正变得越来越小，AI数据中心业务才是增长核心，但公司仍需要维持GeForce品牌和开发者生态，因为GeForce被视为英伟达的根基，也是AI市场得以发展的重要基础。也有观点认为，这类表态只是让英伟达继续留在玩家视野中。类似情况并非英伟达独有：英特尔多次表示其久候的消费级GPU更新“没有死”，AMD去年也表示仍打算提供“市场上最好的主流游戏GPU”，但三家近期都没有新GPU发布，季度发布重点持续转向AI。总体来看，“RTX 5090未停产”的表态缓解了彻底断供的担忧，但在供应链约束和AI优先策略下，短期供应仍将紧张，消费级GPU市场很难迅速恢复稳定。
